description: This file 'util.c' appears to be a C source file implementing utility functions for a dialog or user interface module, primarily involving ncurses-based terminal UI management such as themes, window drawing, text wrapping, button rendering, and item list management.

methods.name: void set_mono_theme(void)
methods.description: Configures the dialog interface theme to a monochrome version by setting attributes to A_NORMAL or A_BOLD as appropriate for various dialog components.

methods.name: void set_classic_theme(void)
methods.description: Configures the dialog interface with a classic color theme by assigning specific foreground and background colors to dialog components.

methods.name: void set_blackbg_theme(void)
methods.description: Configures the dialog interface with a black background theme, setting colors for various components accordingly.

methods.name: void set_bluetitle_theme(void)
methods.description: Extends the classic theme by setting additional blue color highlights for titles and active tags.

methods.name: int set_theme(const char * theme)
methods.description: Selects and applies a color theme based on input string; defaults to bluetitle if no valid theme is provided.

methods.name: void init_one_color(struct dialog_color * color)
methods.description: Initializes a single color pair in ncurses with bold attribute optionally, assigning a color pair number.

methods.name: void init_dialog_colors(void)
methods.description: Initializes all dialog color attributes using init_one_color, setting up color pairs for various dialog UI elements.

methods.name: void color_setup(const char * theme)
methods.description: Sets up color display for dialog based on specified theme and terminal color support.

methods.name: void attr_clear(WINDOW * win,int height,int width,chtype attr)
methods.description: Fills a given ncurses window with a specific attribute, effectively clearing it.

methods.name: void dialog_clear(void)
methods.description: Clears the entire dialog interface, including optional background title and subtitles.

methods.name: int init_dialog(const char * backtitle)
methods.description: Initializes the curses environment, sets cursor position saving, checks display size, sets themes, and prepares the dialog for use.

methods.name: void set_dialog_backtitle(const char * backtitle)
methods.description: Sets a backtitle string for the dialog's display.

methods.name: void set_dialog_subtitles(struct subtitle_list * subtitles)
methods.description: Assigns a list of subtitles to the dialog interface.

methods.name: void end_dialog(int x,int y)
methods.description: Restores cursor position, refreshes screen, and ends the curses window, effectively closing the dialog.

methods.name: void print_title(WINDOW * dialog,const char * title,int width)
methods.description: Displays a centered title at the top of a dialog window, truncated if necessary.

methods.name: void print_autowrap(WINDOW * win,const char * prompt,int width,int y,int x)
methods.description: Outputs a string into a window, wrapping words across multiple lines as needed, handling newlines and spacing.

methods.name: void print_button(WINDOW * win,const char * label,int y,int x,int selected)
methods.description: Renders a button with a label at specified position, highlighting if selected.

methods.name: void draw_box(WINDOW * win,int y,int x,int height,int width,chtype box,chtype border)
methods.description: Draws a rectangle box with specified borders and dimensions, using line drawing characters.

methods.name: void draw_shadow(WINDOW * win,int y,int x,int height,int width)
methods.description: Adds a shadow effect to a window to create a 3D appearance if terminal supports colors.

methods.name: int first_alpha(const char * string,const char * exempt)
methods.description: Finds the first alphabetical character in a string, ignoring characters in parentheses or brackets.

methods.name: int on_key_esc(WINDOW * win)
methods.description: Handles escaped key sequences, filtering out double-escape presses to prevent unintended menu exits.

methods.name: int on_key_resize(void)
methods.description: Handles terminal resize events, clearing the dialog and returning resize key code.

methods.name: void item_reset(void)
methods.description: Clears the current list of dialog items.

methods.name: void item_make(const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Creates a new dialog item with formatted string, adding it to the item list.

methods.name: void item_add_str(const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Appends formatted string to current dialog item text.

methods.name: void item_set_tag(char tag)
methods.description: Sets a tag for the current dialog item.

methods.name: void item_set_data(void * ptr)
methods.description: Associates a pointer to user data with the current dialog item.

methods.name: void item_set_selected(int val)
methods.description: Marks the current dialog item as selected or not.

methods.name: int item_activate_selected(void)
methods.description: Returns true if any selected item is active.

methods.name: void * item_data(void)
methods.description: Retrieves the data pointer associated with the current item.

methods.name: char item_tag(void)
methods.description: Returns the tag character of the current item.

methods.name: int item_count(void)
methods.description: Counts the total number of items in the list.

methods.name: void item_set(int n)
methods.description: Sets the current item by index.

methods.name: int item_n(void)
methods.description: Returns the index of the current item.

methods.name: const char * item_str(void)
methods.description: Returns the text string of the current item.

methods.name: int item_is_selected(void)
methods.description: Returns whether the current item is marked as selected.

methods.name: int item_is_tag(char tag)
methods.description: Checks if the current item's tag matches a given character.
